$comment: V2-06 06-01a colour codemod table (scripts/design/codemod-colors.mjs). Keys: utility property group, then lowercase v1 hex. A value is a semantic token name, or an object keyed by the state variant in the class's variant chain (placeholder, disabled, active, focus, hover; first match in that order) with a 'default'. Values of the semantic tokens live only in app/globals.css (raw v1-* layer); this table never holds colours except the deleted brand scale it resolves.

brandScale.$comment: The v1 --color-brand-* scale deleted from app/globals.css by 06-01a; brand-<step> classes resolve to these hexes, then map like any hex.

named.$comment: Tailwind default-palette classes the codemod replaces (plan 06-01a step 4); every other raw palette class is reported by the UI policy (raw-palette) and left for the screen rebuilds.

fileOverrides.$comment: Per-file semantic choices where the hex alone is ambiguous (same values, so value-neutral).

unmappedOnPurpose.$comment: Interaction-state shades with no semantic slot in DESIGN_SYSTEM §2.3 or the G2-D token file. Left as hex (value-neutral) and reported; their owners replace them with primitives.
unmappedOnPurpose.bg:#912018: danger button hover (components/ui/button.tsx); the 06-02a Button primitive owns danger hover/pressed
unmappedOnPurpose.bg:#7a271a: danger button pressed (components/ui/button.tsx); the 06-02a Button primitive owns danger hover/pressed
unmappedOnPurpose.bg:#146340: success button hover (patients consent section); replaced by the 06-02a Button primitive
unmappedOnPurpose.bg:#ffeacc: warning chip hover (patient visit history); replaced by the 06-03a status/chip patterns

provisional_without_v1_site.$comment: Semantic tokens no v1 hex class maps to. Their 06-01a value is the colour the nearest v1 screen uses today; 06-01b replaces all of them with approved values.
